title: smtp/queue.rs: inject_source_header uses Debug format for InjectionSource
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/smtp/src/queue.rs, inject_source_header formats an InjectionSource value using {:?} (Debug) rather than {} (Display). Debug format is not stable across Rust versions and not intended for wire output; it produces Rust-syntax like SmtpRelay { host: ... } in the header value rather than a human-readable string.

What needs to be done: Implement Display for InjectionSource and use {} formatting, or format the header value manually with the specific fields needed.
